title: VDCores Qwen3-8B Missing-Operator Preflight
command: cd tmp/baselines/vdcores && HF_TOKEN= HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python app/python/qwen3/sched.py --hf-cache-dir <shared-hf-cache>/hub --correctness
observation: The Qwen3-8B path loaded all five offline checkpoint shards and reached dae.launch before VDCores rejected the currently compiled dae.runtime operator set.
blocker: dae.runtime lacks the Qwen3-8B compute operators reported by the launcher, including OP_RMS_NORM_F16_K_4096_SMEM and OP_SILU_MUL_SHARED_BF16_K_64_SW128; rebuild with the full DAE_COMPUTE_OPS set before running correctness or serving timing.
